text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: mean quantile score difference (points of capacity) on days chosen before any score was read (the number of days is in each label, from the five decision substations). Line: 99% interval from resampling 7-day blocks. Every subset has under 60 independent days a year, so all rows are descriptive. The largest-error subset is chosen on GAM-K's own outcomes and flatters any arm that differs from it.'
text.tspan: Dot: mean quantile score difference (points of capacity) on days chosen before any score was
read (the number of days is in each label, from the five decision substations). Line: 99%
interval from resampling 7-day blocks. Every subset has under 60 independent days a year, so
all rows are descriptive. The largest-error subset is chosen on GAM-K's own outcomes and
flatters any arm that differs from it.
